notes.title: Treasure Tile 0.4.1 Update!
notes.content:
[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f3bc0161a4dcd72e72fbca5/b00b0c0f-4176-4a1a-997b-b3b3019b6105/itch_rounded.png?format=1000w[/img]
With the latest update we wanted to focus more on boss battles and the bosses in Treasure Tile in general. While there [i]were [/i]Elite type enemies and even empowered tiles that might ambush you from time to time, there were never any actual true bosses. Like, I mean truly tough baddies. That is until now. The new bosses will be completely unique and not found in any other map. They will also have their own dedicated arenas and numerous unique skills. They can all be met by completing the main story line.
[list]
[*][b] The bosses [/b]are finally here. Sharpen your swords and restring your bows ‘cause these won’t go down easy.
[*] [b]Separate arenas[/b] for each boss so you can hash it out in private.
[*] We’ve [b]upgraded underpowered skills[/b] and [b]downgraded overpowered ones[/b]. Now they’re all just powered.
[*] Higher level enemies and bosses have gained a few extra brain cells.
[/list][img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f3bc0161a4dcd72e72fbca5/c8607216-cd74-4298-89a5-3cea46e31e79/devlog_amalgamation.png?format=750w[/img]

It was high time to upgrade the minimap. The new one is more useful while looking nicer to boot!
[list]
[*] Each biome will now have its own [b]unique colours[/b] for the maps.
[*] [b]Minimap arrows[/b] will now appear when you’re nearing a quest objective. [i]Finally.[/i]
[/list][img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f3bc0161a4dcd72e72fbca5/15331ede-b803-4acf-8fcb-9ea91572200b/devlog_minimap.png?format=750w[/img]

We’ve also added a few smaller updates that I have no doubt will be very welcome additions. There are new passive skills, a shared stash and even some nicer UI.
[list]
[*] [b]Passive skills are here![/b] They’re not done 100% but we’re getting there. Stay tuned!
[*] [b]Shared stash has been added[/b] so that you can finally share the love with all of your characters.
[*] [b]Item level requirements[/b] have been added. 
[*] We’ve updated the [b]HP bar art[/b]. Now you can see your enemies get destroyed in style!
[/list][img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f3bc0161a4dcd72e72fbca5/64467493-646f-425b-ad22-a7b49cc551ac/devlog_stash.png?format=750w[/img]

notes.title: Treasure Tile 0.3.5 update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We’ve updated the skill system to give you more freedom to make your own skills. Instead of using boring old predefined skills you can now make your own. Destroy elite enemies and steal their gemstones ot upgrade your skills. These gemstones will allow you to add devastating effects to your skills or turn them into basic attacks. The sky’s the limit!

[list]
[*] So many new skills added it’s hard to count! Well, not really, it’s 14. We’ve added 14 new skills.
[*] Gemstones can be used to enhance or completely alter the way your skills work.
[*] Some older skills removed that don’t work with the new system.
[*] Skill visual effects have been update so that now you can actually feel them.
[/list]
[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f3bc0161a4dcd72e72fbca5/1633622921907-WOJFRX3C9ZPM1C3TQO2J/skill.png?format=750w[/img]

[list]
[*] Settings screen added. Now you can’t say we don’t listen to feature requests.
[*] You can finally rebind your keys. WASD, arrows, weird 12 button mouse - play however you like. We don’t judge.
[*] NEW TOWN!!! Actually, it’s the old town, but itnow looks 3000% better.
[*] World Map has been updated to look ever so slightly nicer. 
[/list]
[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f3bc0161a4dcd72e72fbca5/1633623805543-TUH1IONL11VR67XP2YVF/settings.png?format=750w[/img]

[list]
[*] Some of the levels got some well needed polish.
[*] New animation added that will show the maps revealing right before your eyes!
[*] The main character art has been updated.
[/list]

[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f3bc0161a4dcd72e72fbca5/1633623542034-MJI4IGYZWG7Z7IJC8H8O/town.png?format=750w[/img]
And so much more! Download it at https://store.steampowered.com/app/1544370/Treasure_Tile/

notes.title: Treasure Tile 0.3.4 update
notes.content:
[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f3bc0161a4dcd72e72fbca5/1630581633918-V4HW8P924QO3IIGCFN9H/enchantress.png?format=1500w[/img]
The new update has dropped with a loot shower of new and improved features! We’ve got a brand new teleport, multiple character support and soooo many item updates.
[list][*] [b]The enchantress[/b] will turn you unenchanted boring items into enchanted awesome ones.
[*] [b]The blacksmith[/b] is here to make sure all your bad affixes are replaced with good affixes. 
[*] [b]Item cards are now beautiful.[/b] Just like you.
[*] [b]Item comparison icons[/b] - put that calculator away, we’ll tell you which items are the best.
[*][b] A sell all function added[/b] so you can stop dragging your items one by one.[/list]
[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f3bc0161a4dcd72e72fbca5/1630583988444-R0XI3NKP7Y970AEBNA5X/blacksmith.png?format=750w[/img]
[list][*] [b]Belts and rings are here.[/b]
[*] [b]Waaay better drop rates.[/b] We’re not stingy, ok?
[*] [b]Events now have rewards.[/b] There are some chests in caves as well.
[*] [b]More affixes.[/b] More is always better.
[*] [b]New item rarity![/b][/list]
[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f3bc0161a4dcd72e72fbca5/1630583945004-82GYNJH7IYO5H5IXH05C/teleport.png?format=750w[/img]
[list][*] [b]Teleport added![/b] No more walking using your legs like a common tile!
[*] [b]Multiple character support[/b] for all you weirdos that didn’t want to delete their previous character when starting a new one.
[*] [b]Evasion added.[/b]
[*] [b]Ancient Woods[/b] has gotten a fresh coat of paint.
[*] [b]New enemy skills[/b] that hit harder, better, faster, stronger.[/list]
[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f3bc0161a4dcd72e72fbca5/1630586006850-L55RAB684G1LXM95L9W9/Enchantress+render+final.png?format=750w[/img]

And so much more! Download it [url=https://golemhouse.itch.io/treasure-tile]here[/url]

notes.title: Making Items Great Again
notes.content:
As the name implies, Treasure Tile is made up of two core ingredients: treasure & tiles. Ok, ok there’s actually more to the game but Treasure Action Skill Quest Procedural Tile was already taken. We had to streamline a little. Anyway, what I want to talk about is the treasure part. 

[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f3bc0161a4dcd72e72fbca5/1630076780424-PAK1PEXPJSN702SEDR5L/items.png?format=1500w[/img]

[h1]Treasure[/h1]

As you may imagine treasure or loot is really important in a loot-based ARPG. You could even say it’s the most important thing. You shouldn’t tho. But you could. And you probably already noticed that loot is something the game ain’t that good with. It’s terrible, but it doesn’t feel complete. What I mean by that is that the drop rates aren’t that exciting, there aren’t that many interesting affixes, buying, selling items seemed somewhat pointless. Worse of all - most of the enemy drops are kinda boring. I mean, if you haven’t noticed it that’s great, but if you have that’s even better.

That was by design. Now I know how that sounds. “Why the hell would you make a loot ARPG with boring loot” I hear [i](hope)[/i] you’re saying. Well as you may already know we’re using a development model where we take in the feedback of our players and try to implement it. That means that the overall design of the game has to be as dynamic and malleable as possible. This way once we start realizing what direction our players are expecting from the game we can easily adapt. But for that to happen we couldn’t really commit to any core features at the very beginning. That’s why when we were implementing items we wanted them to be as basic as could be. You could destroy enemies, they’d drop look and you’d equip loot. That was all we needed.

[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f3bc0161a4dcd72e72fbca5/1630079893878-P8JKQ7M1HPUVP71BP22S/canyon.png?format=1000w[/img]

[h1]That does sound basic[/h1]

Exactly. So for the next version we’re finally fixing this. This update might be a bit on the annoying side since most of the fixes won’t be [i]that [/i]visible and there’s a lot of under-the-hood stuff that we had to implement, but here’s a few: We’re adding a way to increase your item’s quality level (more on that in the version announcement). You’ll also be able to change up the affixes you find on items and replace them with something better (or worse). You’ll also be able to restock the shop if it doesn’t have anything cool available. This will hopefully give you more control when deciding whether to save up for that new armor set or try to upgrade the old one.

Another thing that’s changing is how the items are dropped. We’ve completely changed the drop rates and drop counts which means you’ll see larger piles of items more often. [b]HUUUGE DISCLAIMER[/b] that the word [i]large[/i] means different things to different folks. A collection of 4 items is pretty large for us. Pretty large indeed. Don’t @ me when you don’t get that 50+ item shower you were dreaming about all these years. There’s also a greater variety of affixes with some being much rarer than others. You’ll also sometimes (rarely tho) get drops that don’t relate to your class. You can, like, I dunno. Use them as a cool door stop. Maybe a paper weight. You’ll figure it out. The way the items scale has also been tweaked a bit. OP items at the very start of the game will be less common. There’s also a whole new rarity added to game. Guess what color that’s gonna be.

The last one doesn’t make sense on paper, but it feels great, [b]trust me[/b]. We’ve added comparison icons that will tell you whether an item is stronger that the one you currently have [i]before you pick it up[/i]. It’s hard to explain, but knowing if you need the item or not kinda feels awesome and you don’t have to recheck [i][b]every. single. item.[/b][/i] We’ve also updated the UI so that higher rarity items actually pop on the screen instead of blending into it. Also, now, when you pick up an item it’ll have a nice lil’ NEW tag the first time you open the inventory. Dunno why, but it just feels nice to see where them OP gloves gone to after you picked them up.

[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f3bc0161a4dcd72e72fbca5/1630079342452-AU5LCECR0QOBHIHLP5A9/magma.png?format=1500w[/img]

[h1]Is that it?[/h1]

Not even. There’s a bunch of new changes all over the place. Some minor, some major. One particular of note is that we’ve added TELEPORTS!!! I mean, we’ve had a [i]Go to town button[/i] but that just wasn’t it. Now you’ll be able to summon a baby waypoint that’ll take you to town and wait for you to come back. Then, when you do come back, the map will remain [i]exactly the way you left it[/i]. This should make trips to the shop painless and waaay quicker. OH! And I almost forgot. We had this super groundbreaking idea of multiple characters. It came to me in a dream once. But basically, and stay with me, now, you’ll be able to create more than one character. AND creating a second character won’t delete your first one. Amazing, I know. 

I honestly can’t wait for you guys to try it. Stay tuned for next Thursday. It’s coming!
[url=https://discord.gg/VqJgAyvpUF][img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f3bc0161a4dcd72e72fbca5/1629372200585-3DX3OQ0XJHC47MAKRHWF/join_us_on_discord.png?format=500w[/img][/url]
